policy: Records distinguish engineering assessments from actual maintainer approvals. An engineering record names its actor, Unix-millisecond assessment time, selected declared license, evidence and limitations; it is not a human approval or a legal guarantee. Pending tooling records remain visible. Distribution readiness evaluates the components actually shipped in the frontend; full inventory completeness is reported separately.

This engineering assessment addresses source availability; it does not assert the exact historical upstream checkout, byte-for-byte reproduction, complete observable equivalence or a legal guarantee.
provenanceLimitations: The upstream workflow did not pin the historical ELK checkout used to produce its published worker.
